# Coming this month: Fast, free Wi-Fi to expand across Delta’s trans-Pacific network for full global connectivity


Beginning this month, fast, free Delta Sync Wi-Fi presented by T-Mobile will roll out across Delta’s trans-Pacific routes. Once activated, the expansion will bring the final major region of Delta’s global network online for fast, free Wi-Fi.


Staff Writer


Oct 9, 2026 4:00pm


With nearly 1,300 Wi‑Fi-equipped aircraft already flying around the world—more than 95% of its fleet—Delta is preparing for the next chapter in its connectivity journey: the airline has reached a major milestone receiving regulatory approval to extend fast, free Delta Sync Wi‑Fi across its trans-Pacific routes, bringing customers one step closer to staying connected around the globe. The rollout will begin later this month, expanding progressively across routes in the following weeks.


The trans-Pacific expansion marks the final step toward extending connectivity across Delta's global route network. With Wi-Fi activated across the Pacific, Delta will become **the only U.S. global carrier to offer free Wi-Fi across its global network** , spanning six continents. That reach is especially meaningful on some of Delta’s longest flights, keeping customers connected whether they're working, streaming, messaging or simply keeping up from the air.


Delta recognized early that customers increasingly expect to stay connected, informed, productive and entertained wherever they travel. As Delta continues to build on that vision, the airline is focused on strengthening the connected travel experience for customers around the world.
